process.title: Apply Online
process.text: Submit your CV, a short statement of purpose, and your availability using the form below

process.title: Shortlisting
process.text: We review all applications within 5 working days and contact shortlisted candidates by email

process.title: Brief Interview
process.text: A 20-minute video or phone call to understand your interests and match you to the right project

process.title: Onboarding
process.text: Orientation session, project briefing, and introduction to your supervisor and team members

items.title: Socio-Economic Research Intern
items.text: Assist with field surveys, data collection, analysis, and report writing for AWSAR's baseline and impact assessment studies. Quantitative skills preferred.

items.title: Child Rights & Protection Intern
items.text: Support child protection case documentation, legal aid coordination, and community awareness campaigns. Hindi fluency essential.

items.title: Public Health & Nutrition Intern
items.text: Assist with health camp coordination, maternal health data collection, and nutrition awareness programmes in underserved urban communities.

items.title: Gender & Livelihoods Intern
items.text: Support women's livelihood and financial inclusion programmes — training facilitation, market linkages, and SHG documentation.

items.title: Communications & Design Intern
items.text: Create field stories, social media content, IEC materials, and programme reports. Canva, Adobe, or similar tools helpful.

items.title: Monitoring & Evaluation Intern
items.text: Support programme monitoring, indicator tracking, data visualisation, and quarterly progress reporting across AWSAR's project portfolio.

items.title: Senior Research Officer
items.detail: Master's in Social Science, Economics, Statistics, or Public Health. PhD an advantage.
items.text: Lead quantitative and qualitative research — study design, fieldwork, analysis, and dissemination. Minimum 5 years in social or development research. SPSS/STATA/R preferred.

items.title: Programme Manager — Child Protection
items.detail: MSW (Child & Family Welfare or similar). Hindi fluency essential.
items.text: Oversee AWSAR's child protection programmes — community child protection systems and survivor rehabilitation. Minimum 4 years in child rights or protection with team management experience.

items.title: Communications & Fundraising Officer
items.text: Drive AWSAR's external communications, donor stewardship, grant writing, and digital presence. Write compelling field stories, manage CSR proposals. 3+ years in development communications.

items.title: Field Coordinator — Women's Empowerment
items.detail: BSW/MSW or Graduate with 2+ years in women's development. Hindi & local language fluency essential.
items.text: On-ground coordination of women's livelihood and skills training programmes. Mobilise community women's groups, facilitate training sessions, maintain programme records. Field travel required.
